why: Which Wisent product calls which other Wisent product, and what a person who does not have the other product gets: an alternative, a refusal that names what is missing, or a degraded answer. A machine is not assumed to hold every product. Every entry cites the source lines it was read from; `las dependencies check` re-reads them, so an entry whose code moved or changed is reported instead of trusted.

outcomes.alternative: the product works without the other one through the path named in `alternative`
outcomes.refusal: the feature stops with an error; `detail` says what the error says
outcomes.degraded: the feature goes on with less; `detail` says what is lost and whether it is said
